programme.desc: Gingka derrota a Chris en el combate pero lo convence de que es un blader legendario y que forma parte del equipo y no está solo. Aguma es derrotado por Tithi y Dynamis convence a Aguma de que lo acompañe para seguir a Gingka y los demás. Gingka llega al templo de Nemesis, donde se encuentra con Pluto, Rago y, para su sorpresa, Doji.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: En un templo de Méjico, Rago se enfrenta a todos los que le retan, incluido Gingka y sus amigos y Ryuga. Ninguno de sus beys tiene efecto sobre el Diablo Nemesis de Rago, pues los lanza a todos por los aires. Antes de que Gingka y los demás puedan decidir qué hacer, Rago utiliza el poder de Diablo Nemesis para destruir el templo. Gingka y sus amigos son rescatados por Tsubasa, que los lleva de vuelta al cuartel general de la AMCB.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Mientras la AMCB y todos sus miembros están peinando el mundo en busca de Rago y Nemesis, Gingka y sus amigos se entrenan para el combate que les espera. Mientras, Rago, Doji y Pluto están en un barco en medio del océano, e intentan sacar a la superficie el reino hundido del rey Hades. Cuando Gingka y los demás localizan a los malvados en el océano Pacífico, corren al helicóptero de la

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka y sus amigos se dirigen hacia Nemesis en el océano Pacífico, pero el helicóptero en el que vuelan atraviesa una peligrosa tormenta. Se ven obligados a aterrizar en una isla desierta y utilizan barcas para llegar al reino perdido del rey Hades, donde creen que se encuentra Nemesis. Entre tanto, Ryuga ya ha llegado al reino perdido y ha retado a Rago y su Nemesis a un combate contra él y su bey L-Drago.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka y sus amigos intentan ayudar a Ryuga, que ha sido gravemente herido en el combate contra Rago, pero parece que es demasiado tarde para salvarlo. Sin Ryuga, Dynamis les dice que la barrera de Zeus no puede ser completada y ya no pueden obtener la ayuda de la madre naturaleza. Están solos. Los bladers legendarios y sus amigos atacan a Rago y su bey Nemesis, pero son repelidos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Kenta y su nuevo bey, Flash Sagittario, se enfrentan a Rago y su bey, Diablo Nemesis. Gingka está convencido de que Kenta ahora tiene los poderes del blader legendario de la constelación estival, Ryuga. Los demás están de acuerdo e intentan levantar una vez más la barrera de Zeus para intentar enterrar al dios de la destrucción. Primero, el Sagittario de Kenta derrota al Darkhelm de Pluto y después todos los bladers se

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka y el resto de los bladers legendarios de las cuatro estaciones aparecen para completar la barrera de Zeus y enterrar a Nemesis para siempre, junto con Rago y Pluto, que se hunden también con la destrucción del reino perdido de Hades. La celebración dura poco, pues una pequeña fisura en la barrera de Zeus permite al dios de la destrucción reaparecer para destruir la Tierra.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka ha reunido el poder de todos los beys de sus amigos y él y Pegasus se enfrentan a Nemesis. Gingka lucha con todas sus fuerzas pero pronto se da cuenta de que el poder de Pegasus es equivalente al poder de Nemesis. Rago le provoca diciéndole que el sol negro destruirá la tierra mucho antes de que Gingka pueda derrotarlo. Las tornas cambian cuando todos los bladers del mundo envían su poder a Gingka y Pegasus y su nueva fuerza lanzan varias

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Cuando Kenta se enfrenta a los Cazadores de Caras en una batalla de cuatro contra uno y pierde, Gingka entra para darle una lección a la pandilla. Él rápidamente derrota a los matones y sus beyblades. Al día siguiente, los Cazadores de caras están de vuelta con refuerzos y su líder Kyoya. Rodean a Gingka y lo obligan a una batalla de cien a uno. Gingka se mantiene enfocado y derrota a los cien oponentes. Kyoya está impresionado y desafía a Gingka a un duelo ...

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: El nuevo amigo de Gingka, Madoka, es un experto técnico de Beyblade y trabaja en el Pegaso roto. Mientras tanto, los Cazadores de caras toman la hoja de beyblade de Kenta y se niegan a devolverla a menos que Gingka pelee con Kyoya en una batalla. Gingka acepta el desafío a pesar de las súplicas de Madoka de que Pegaso no está listo. Durante la batalla, el beyblade de Kyoya parece impenetrable, pero Pegasus puede sobrevivir y ganar.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kenta teme que Gingka salga de la ciudad para encontrar oponentes más valiosos, por lo que desafía a Gingka a un hombre contra otro en batalla. Mientras tanto, Kyoya y sus Cazadores de caras son llevados a un área rocosa aislada por una misteriosa figura, Doji. Doji desafía a Kyoya a una batalla; acuerdan que si Kyoya pierde, tendrá que trabajar para que Doji derrote a Gingka. La pelea está en marcha y Rock Leone de Kyoya resulta no ser rival para el Lobo Oscuro de Doji.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Benkei está devastado por la pérdida de su mentor Kyoya, quien se unió a Doji como una forma de pagar una deuda. Así que Benkei se sorprende al recibir una visita del mismo Doji que le presenta un poderoso Beyblade, Dark Bull. A cambio, Doji quiere que Benkei lo use para derrotar a Gingka. Benkei acepta y entrena duro. Gingka y Benkei luchan y el Pegaso de Gingka prevalece al final. Por un momento parece que los dos enemigos se harán amigos, pero no es para ser ...

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Gingka se niega a luchar contra un villano obsesionado con los cangrejos llamado Tetsuya Watarigani, pero cuando Watarigani revela que se ha llevado a Madoka y no la liberará hasta que Gingka acepte luchar, Gingka no tiene otra opción. Se produce una batalla acalorada, con mucho juego encubierto por parte de Watarigani. Justo cuando Gingka está contra la pared, Madoka regresa. Ella fue salvada por nada menos que ... Benkei.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Los Cazadores de caras se encuentran con Hikaru Hasama, quien hizo un voto a su madre hace años de que se convertiría en la mejor beyblader del mundo. Ella sabe que debe vencer a Gingka, así que lo desafía a través de Benkei. Gingka se ha resfriado y Madoka insiste en que descanse un poco antes de volver a luchar.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Benkei es mentor de Kenta para que el joven espadachín pueda enfrentar a Hikaru nuevamente y derrotarla. Madoka le da a Kenta una cara de metal para agregar a su bey de Sagitario y le dice que podría ayudarlo a crear un movimiento especial. Mientras tanto, Hikaru descubre que no derrotó a Gingka, fue Kenta haciéndose pasar por Gingka.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Para demostrar su disposición a luchar contra Gingka, Doji envía a Kyoya al Cañón del Lobo, donde debe escalar una montaña traicionera, combatiendo los elementos, incluidos los lobos salvajes. Mientras tanto, los jóvenes amigos de Kenta le ruegan a Benkei que los entrene también y él cede.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Cuando Kyoya regresa de Wolf Canyon, disuelve a los Cazadores de caras y desafía a Benkei a una batalla que resulta ser destructiva. Kenta llega para ayudar a Benkei, pero fue en vano: los ataques de Kyoya son tan intensos que el almacén en sí está destruido. Mientras tanto, Gingka alcanza a Hikaru, la felicita por su batalla con Kenta y la reta a una batalla.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kenta lleva de vuelta a la Benkei B-Pit y parece que está en su último aliento ... le pide Gingka para enseñar Kyoya el verdadero significado de beyblading. Gingka promete hacerlo justo cuando Benkei comienza a roncar. Gingka encuentra con Kyoya y la lucha está en Kyoya con la creación de un tornado que rasga a través de la ciudad. La multitud se reúne y anima a Gingka.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: búsquedas gingka para Doji y la sede de la nebulosa oscura determinaron para encontrar Prohibida Bey de Doji, L-Drago, que es el mal. La pandilla ayuda a Gingka a buscar, pero no es hasta que Kyoya aparece con una pista de que pueden encontrar la Nebulosa Oscura. Fuera de la fortaleza, Doji envía una variedad de ataques beyblade su camino.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Gingka, Kyoya, Kenta, Madoka y Benkei paseo por el castillo Dark Nebula donde la voz de Doji reta para que sea a la planta superior. Ellos tratan de subir, pero Merci ha puesto en marcha una serie de obstáculos para ellos, incluyendo el mal patinadores individuales. Kyoya insiste en que puede manejarlos mientras Gingka continúa solo. Kyoya utiliza Lion 100 Fang Fury y derriba a los gemelos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: En el interior del castillo de Dark Nebula, Gingka encuentra cara a cara con un némesis perdido hace mucho tiempo ... Ryuga que lleva el Bey Prohibida, L-Drago. Gingka revela que Ryuga es la única persona que nunca perdonará. A sobreviene de batalla en el que la ira de los combustibles gingka L-Drago poder. Ryuga le incita a ir contando Gingka que su padre no era fuerte tampoco.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kenta se enfrenta a Gingka y Gingka habla sobre su pasado. Nos enteramos de que el padre de Gingka, Ryo, era el dueño original del Bey Pegasus y un archirival de Ryuga. Ryuga derrotó a Ryo en una batalla entre Pegasus y el Prohibido Bey Lightning L-Drago. Las últimas palabras de Ryo a su hijo son derrotar a Ryuga para que pueda devolver a L-Drago al lugar que le corresponde.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Cuando Kenta encuentra una carta de Gingka que dice adiós, la pandilla se dispuso a encontrarlo en su pueblo natal de Koma Village. Frente a los desafíos de cruzar una montaña traicionera en el camino hacia la aldea, Kyoya y Benkei toman una ruta mientras que Madoka y Kenta toman otra. Ambas partes se encuentran independientemente con un misterioso viajero llamado Hyoma que los ayuda, pero al mismo tiempo parece no decir la verdad.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Benkei, Kyoya, Kenta y Madoka siguen a su nueva guía, Hyoma, por los traicioneros senderos de montaña mientras intentan encontrar la aldea de Koma y reunirse con Gingka. Kyoya sospecha que Hyoma los está guiando en círculos y lo demuestra. También expone a Hyoma como Blader y lo reta a una batalla. Tanto Kenta como Benkei luchan contra Hyoma y su bey Aries y son derrotados.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: La pandilla finalmente llega a Koma Village, pero Gingka no está allí. Se encuentran con un perro sabio y parlante llamado Hokuto que es un viejo amigo de Gingka. Hokuto les dice que Gingka está en la montaña para encontrar un pergamino que está escondido dentro de un santuario que se encuentra en el pico más alto. Gingka está decidido a encontrar el pergamino que podría ser la respuesta a más poder para Pegasus.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Recién salido de su experiencia rejuvenecedora en la montaña, Gingka se reúne con la pandilla en Koma Village. Él y Hyoma muestran a sus amigos todos los lugares geniales de beyblading con los que solían luchar cuando eran niños. Finalmente, llegan a Green Hades, donde Gingka nunca pudo derrotar a Hyoma. Hyoma desafía a Gingka nuevamente y, por primera vez, Gingka gana gracias a su movimiento especial Pegasus Starblast Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Cuando Madoka realiza el mantenimiento de los beys, intercambia las partes en Sagittario y Bull, lo que le da una fuerza sorprendente a sus actuaciones. Benkei y Kenta deciden aprovechar sus nuevas

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Doji lleva a Ryuga a un terreno remoto donde se encuentra con un niño misterioso que es un formidable oponente de Beyblade. Mientras tanto, Gingka y sus amigos participan en la competencia Survival Battle en Beyblade Island, cuyo ganador recibe un deseo. Todos están compitiendo, incluido Tetsuya, quien atrapa a Benkei y a algunos bladers injustamente hasta que cambian la situación.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: La batalla de supervivencia continúa y todos luchan duro para mantenerse con vida. Kyoya y Hikaru luchan entre sí, pero son interrumpidos por otros espadachines que los emboscan. Cuando luchan contra ellos con éxito, Kyoya se enfrenta a Hyoma y luchan entre sí hasta que Kyoya lo derrota.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: En un sorprendente final de la batalla de supervivencia, todo se reduce a Kyoya, Gingka, Madoka y Yu. En una feroz batalla entre Kyoya y Yu, la pandilla descubre que el bey de Kyoya se rompió en su batalla anterior con Hyoma, y si continúa luchando contra Yu, podría dañarse para siempre. Depende de Madoka, todavía un competidor en la carrera, luchar contra Kyoya, para informarle sobre su bey y salvarlo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: A Yu se le concede su deseo de ganar la Batalla de supervivencia. Él desea Battle Bladers, la batalla de bey más grande de todos los tiempos que determinará el blader número 1 del país. Doji llega y pronto se revela que todo esto ha sido parte de su complot: controlar Battle Bladers, para que Ryuga pueda derrotar a todos y Lightning L-Drago pueda absorber todo el poder de los oponentes.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Las batallas se están calentando en todas partes con los bladers ansiosos por ganar puntos para participar en la gran competencia Battle Bladers; Benkei, Kenta, Hikaru y Kyoya son especialmente exitosos acumulando más puntos. Mientras tanto, Gingka conoce a un nuevo rival, Tsubasa, quien le enseña algunos trucos del oficio.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kyoya está frustrado porque sus oponentes no lo desafían. Él derriba a un oponente tras otro, incluidos grupos de ellos al mismo tiempo. Está aburrido hasta que conoce a Tobio ... también conocido como el Capitán Capri. El petulante Tobio calcula cada movimiento que parece errático, lo que lo convierte en una buena competencia contra el salvaje Kyoya.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Doji y Yu están buscando talentos para llevar a los Battle Bladers para que Ryuga pueda absorber su poder. Para su sorpresa, Tsubasa derrota a su espada en un torneo pero no pueden encontrar ninguna información sobre quién es este Tsubasa. Sorprendentemente, Tsubasa más tarde aparece en la sede de Dark Nebula con ganas de vender sus habilidades.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: La competencia para llegar a Battle Bladers se calienta cuando Blader DJ anuncia dos ubicaciones para torneos: una en el bosque y la otra junto al río. Kenta domina la competencia forestal mientras Hyoma lidera la etapa del río. Ambas batallas dan grandes vueltas cuando los no invitados espadachines Tsubasa y Yu rompen las fiestas.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Se trata de los últimos partidos desafiantes para Battle Bladers. Tetsuya Watagani está a la altura de sus viejos trucos eliminando oponentes con historias llorosas. Sus tácticas incluso funcionan contra Benkei, ya que finge ser su amigo y se aprovecha de él para ganar las semifinales. Ahora depende de Gingka y Tetsuya, pero Gingka no se dejará engañar.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: En medio de una lucha desafiante para Battle Bladers, Kenta se encuentra con un oponente luchador llamado Sora. Todos están impresionados con su increíble poder y agilidad ... hasta que pierde el control y finalmente pierde la batalla con Kenta. Más tarde, Kenta se pone al día con Sora, quien dice ser un aprendiz de Gingka, pero su historia es sospechosa.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Gingka, Benkei, Kenta y Madoka se enfrentan a un gran desafío de 10,000 puntos. Mientras esperan para competir, se encuentran con un adivino / espadachín, Ryutaro, quien dice ser fanático de Gingka. Gingka se sorprende cuando conoce a Ryutaro en su primer partido del torneo. Ryutaro se hace cargo del partido con "magia" y Gingka está en su ingenio para vencer a este oponente. Al final, Gingka descubre el plan de Ryutaro y él y Pegasus giran hacia la victoria.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: En un día emocionante de lucha, Blader DJ anuncia cuatro batallas en cuatro estadios diferentes a la vez. Mientras Kenta lucha por contener al dúo fraternal de Dan y Reiki, Benkei mira esa batalla, pierde el foco en su propia batalla y es derrotado por Tsubasa. Hyoma gana por poco contra Hikaru, mientras que Yu derriba a su oponente tan fácilmente que está molesto porque no tuvo una batalla más dura.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Solo quedan seis bladers en el último Beyblade Challenge Match. En un giro sorpresa, se les dice que la ronda final será un Battle Royal donde los seis competirán entre sí por los 10,000 Puntos Bey. En una temible final, las alianzas se forman y rompen y las tensiones aumentan, pero al final solo un Blader sigue girando para reclamar la victoria ... ¡Kyoya!

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Gingka un nuevo Digital Power Launcher que calcula su poder de lanzamiento mientras practica y también lleva sus puntos ganados en la batalla. Cuando Tetsuya se disfraza, los engaña para que le den el Bey Pointer de Gingka y trata de huir con él. Phoenix viene al rescate, pero luego desafía la voluntad de Gingka como espadachín, es decir, si realmente estuviera decidido a ganar, cuidaría mejor su puntero.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Después de haber perdido todos sus puntos en un partido anterior con Phoenix, Gingka está decidido a ganar cada partido hasta que llegue a Battle Bladers y finalmente pueda derrotar a Ryuga. En su primer combate, conoce a Teru, un blader que solía ser un bailarín talentoso hasta que estuvo involucrado en un accidente en el escenario.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Ryuga reaparece y comienza a competir y ganar varios partidos de desafío, ganando puntos a medida que avanza. Tsubasa está intrigado por el poder de L-Drago y se cuela en la sede de la Nebulosa Oscura para buscar datos sobre el 'bey prohibido'. Tsubasa aprende mucho, pero antes de que pueda escapar con la información, es atrapado por Doji y Yu y debe luchar contra un variedad de cuchillas Dark Nebula.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: En una acalorada batalla entre Tsubasa y Ryuga, Tsubasa está casi derrotado hasta que el misterioso Phoenix vuela y se hace cargo de la batalla, haciendo posible que Tsubasa escape. Más tarde, Gingka se enfrenta a Tobio (también conocido como Capitán Capri) en un estadio con paredes en movimiento. Mientras Doji y Yu observan, Capri usa sus habilidades de francotirador para aprovechar las paredes móviles.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kenta llega a lo que parece ser un pueblo fantasma, pero se encuentra con algunos bladers que aún viven allí a pesar de que el estadio local ha sido tomado por una pandilla dirigida por Busujima. Kenta también se encuentra con su viejo amigo Sora, quien ha venido para luchar contra la pandilla y ganar el estadio para todos. Sora pierde mucho, pero con Kenta y la ayuda de la gente del pueblo, ¡lo intenta de nuevo y gana!

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: La pandilla celebra la calificación para los Battle Bladers cuando Gingka revela que no tiene suficientes puntos para lograrlo. Le ofrecen luchar contra él, pero él se niega, ya que no quiere poner en riesgo a sus amigos. Tsubasa llega y desafía a los bladers, pero Gingka tiene que despegar para hacer el último desafío. Mientras tanto, Hyoma, Hikaru y Benkei pierden puntos ante el feroz Tsubasa.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Phoenix lucha contra Tsubasa diciendo que si puede vencer a Phoenix, puede luchar contra Gingka. Phoenix supera a Tsubasa en una intensa batalla y luego desafía a Gingka. Cuando Gingka se encuentra contra la pared, Phoenix le recuerda el voto que hizo de que si pierde una batalla, dejará de ser beyblading para siempre.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: ¡Comienza Battle Bladers! Gingka y sus amigos llegan a la gran competencia de Battle Bladers, donde descubren que Doji está a cargo y los emparejamientos de batalla parecen un poco a su favor. No importa, Benkei derriba al Capitán Capri, Kenta vence a Tetsuya y en un impresionante combate final, Gingka elimina a Yu.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kyoya y Tsubasa ganan sus combates iniciales en Battle Bladers, y luego es el turno de Hyoma. Se enfrenta a un espadachín desconocido, Reiji, un miembro de la Nebulosa Oscura. El bey de Reiji, Poison Serpent, no parece muy fuerte en sus ataques, pero Hyoma se da cuenta demasiado tarde de que cada vez que su bey Aries es golpeado, se le inyecta veneno que debilita sus defensas.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Los oponentes para la próxima ronda de Battle Bladers están listos, pero la pandilla está más preocupada por la salud de Hikaru, quien fue derrotado por Ryuga en las batallas iniciales. Ella está bien, y los bladers se dan cuenta de que deben concentrarse en ganar sus próximos partidos si quieren vengar su pérdida. Mientras tanto en Dark Nebula HQ, Yu se ve obligado a luchar contra Reiji para decidir si es digno de permanecer en la Organización.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: En la segunda ronda de Battle Bladers, Doji hace sus trucos habituales, cambiando las parejas de todos. Esto enfrenta a Benkei contra su ídolo Kyoya en una batalla desafiante que Kyoya gana a pesar de la increíble demostración de fuerza de Benkei. Gingka lucha contra el intenso Ryutaro, que tiene mucho en juego en esta batalla.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: La pandilla está alarmada por la forma en que la Nebulosa Oscura ha tratado a Yu, ya que está muy herido después de su batalla con Reiji. Kenta promete derrotar a Reiji por Yu y por todos los verdaderos espadachines. En su batalla con Reiji, Kenta engaña al oscuro nebulizador intercambiando su punta de rendimiento de Sagittario con la punta de la espada de Yu, Libra.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Tsubasa se prepara para su batalla más difícil, contra Ryuga y su bey Lightning L-Drago. Tsubasa tiene un plan para derrotar al Movimiento Oscuro de Ryuga y resulta efectivo ya que él y su bey Earth Eagle toman una ventaja temprana en su batalla. Sin embargo, la pelea termina con Ryuga triunfando y Tsubasa y Eagle ahora están fuera de Battle Bladers.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Las semifinales de Battle Bladers demuestran ser emocionantes con Gingka enfrentando a su oponente inductor de miedo, Reiji. Mientras tanto, Yu es llevado cautivo por Doji para cumplir con su deuda con la Nebulosa Oscura. Hyoma y Kenta ven a Doji llevándose a Yu y deciden no decirle a Gingka, ya que él está en un partido importante. Van a la Nebulosa Oscura para salvar a Yu, pero se encuentran con los secuaces de Doji.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: El intento de Kenta y Hyoma de rescatar a Yu parece haber fallado, hasta que Phoenix llega al cuartel general de Dark Nebula y entra en una terrible batalla contra Doji. En Battle Bladers, Gingka es empujado al límite cuando Reiji usa la Serpiente Venenosa para congelar a Gingka. Pero Gingka utiliza un enfoque de espejo en el que Pegasus refleja los ataques. Reiji se frustra cada vez más por la falta de miedo de Gingka hasta que Gingka finalmente toma el partido.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Gingka y la pandilla se sorprenden al saber que el enmascarado Phoenix es en realidad el padre de Gingka, Ryo. Ryo se disculpa con un molesto Gingka por no revelar que todavía estaba vivo. Explica que tuvo que esconderse para luchar contra la Nebulosa Oscura. Ryo le dice a Gingka y a sus amigos que son los únicos que ahora pueden derrotar a Ryuga y Lightning L-Drago.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kyoya debe enfrentar a Ryuga en las semifinales de vida o muerte en Battle Bladers, el ganador para enfrentar a Gingka en el combate final. Kyoya se burla de Ryuga alegando que no puede enfrentarse solo a sus oponentes: primero debe robar el poder y la fuerza de otros espadachines. Ryuga acepta un desafío de Kyoya para hacer una batalla bey-to bey, sin restricciones. - Open

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: La pandilla todavía se está recuperando de la feroz victoria de Ryuga sobre Kyoya que dejó a su amigo débil e inconsciente. Ryuga le dice a Gingka que es culpa de Gingka que todos sus amigos sufren cuando luchan contra Ryuga, ya que solo los estaba usando para reunir más poder para llegar a Gingka. Gingka se da cuenta de que debe luchar duro contra Ryuga, por el bien de sus amigos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Gingka se encuentra en una batalla, no con Ryuga, sino con una versión mutada de él, una criatura horrible. Gingka se niega a retroceder, y él y Pegasus luchan duro contra Dark Ryuga y su bey L-Drago. Sin embargo, el poder de L-Drago parece ser demasiado para Pegasus, hasta que Gingka se da cuenta de que ganar por la fuerza no es la respuesta.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson vuelve a casa después de ganar el campeonato mundial de BeyBlade y se cree muy importante. Pero llega tarde a la escuela y lo castigan, lo que hace que llegue también tarde a un torneo local. Cuando al fin se presenta, tiene que pelear con un chico misteriorso, míster X, que llega hasta la final para enfrentarse a Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Kenny descubre que Ozuma, el Blader encapuchado que derrotó a Tyson, usó un Bit Beast invisible. Tyson exige una revancha y vuelve a perder, porque Dragoon se niega a aparecer cuando lo llama. Entretanto, unos hombres vestidos de negro han tomado datos de los encuentros entre Ozuma y Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson no supera su derrota con el misterioso Míster X. Max y Ray reciben también la visita de figuras de encapuchados y pierden también con ellos. Kenny descubre algo interesante sobre el BeyBlade de Míster X , pero antes de que pueda decírselo a Tyson, éste se encuentra en el parque con Míster X y lo reta a una revancha.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los hombres de negro secuestran a Kenny y Hilary y Tison se ve obligado a hacer lo que le piden los captores para intentar liberarlos. Termina en un barco viejo, donde tiene que enfrentarse a un robot para que los secuestradores suelten a sus amigos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson y Kenny están otra vez sanos y salvos en tierra firme y acaban deduciendo que hay gente que quiere robar los Bit Beasts de todos los miembros de los BladeBreakers. Etretanto, en la escuela de Kai hay un chico, Wyatt, que quiere que le enseñe técnicas de juego. Kai no le hace caso hasta que un tal Dunga reta a Wyatt y éste roba a Dranzer para la batalla.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: En el centro de entrenamiento de Gideon, dos de sus secuaces descubren a un Blader de talento llamado Snakey y le ofrecen ponerle un Magtram a su Blade. El Magtram es un mecanismo que crea un campo magnético y da una ventaja injusta al que lo usa. Tyson acepta pelear con Snakey y consigue ganar, pero los secuaces de Gideon graban la pelea.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson y Kenny intentan averiguar qué había dentro del Beyblade de Snakey. Envían un mensaje a la madre de Max para pedirle ayuda y van también a ver al señor Dickenson. En su oficina conocen a un equipo nuevo llamado los Psykicks y liderado por el siniestro doctor B.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Max y Ray se unen también con sus amigos, con lo que los BladeBreakers vuelven a estar juntos. La madre de Max les ofrece el Núcleo Mg, que produce un campo magnético similar al del Magtram, pero no es fácil de controlar y tienen que entrenar mucho para lograrlo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los BladeBreakers se dirigen a un torneo contra el equipo Psykick, pero el conductor del autobús llena el vehículo de gas para dormir y mientras están inconscientes los traslada a una isla desierta donde habita el doctor B., que tiene la misión de capturar los Bit Beast de nuestros amigos con un Sistema de Captura de Bit Beasts.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los BladeBreakers están atrapados en una isla misteriosa y deciden separarse. Unos van hacia el faro para intentar comunicarse con el mundo exterior y pedir ayuda y otros, Tyson, Ray y Max, llegan accidentalmente al escenario de su próximo combate, donde tienen que enfrentarse a Bat, un Blader que ve en la oscuridad. Es Ray el que lucha con él y acaba ganando.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes siguen atrapados en la isla, pero el doctor B les dice que si vencen a todos los miembros del equipo Psykick podrán salir. Faltan Tyson y Kai por luchar. Kai se enfrenta a Figel y gana. Después de eso, llega al faro con Kenny y Hilary y piden ayuda. Entretanto, Tyson lucha con Daryl y también vence. El laboratorio del doctor B explota debido a una sobrecarga de ordenador y el señor Dickenson y el abuelo aparecen en helicóptero y rescatan a los chicos en el último momento.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson se recupera de una herida en el tobillo en el hospital. Gideon, entretanto, prepara otro plan siniestro y pide al doctor B que cree un Bit Beast virtual con todos los datos reunidos de los BladeBreakers. En otro lado de la ciudad, los Saint Shields planean también su estrategia para hacerse con los Bit Beasts de los BladeBreakers.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Joseph, de los Saint Shields, descubre el plan de Gideon y el doctor B. Los BladeBreakers entrenan mucho para prepararse para futuros peligros. Mariam incita a Max a una batalla en un bosque cercano. Ray se encuentra a su vez con Joseph y los cuatro pelean dos a dos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Ozuma, el jefe de los Saint Shields, reta a Tyson a un combate. Tyson gana, pero Ozuma le dice que tiene que mejorar su técnica. Entretanto, el doctor B termina de crear su Cyber Bit Beats y lo prueba con Gerry, uno de los Bladers del equipo Psykick, en un torneo local. Los BladeBreakers aparecen en el torneo y ven el Beast.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Gerry no puede controlar su Cyber Bit Beast, que acaba explotando. Kenny descubre que alguien ha hecho copias de los Bit Beasts de sus amigos. Los Saint Shields están entrenando para luchar y el doctor B sigue experimentando para crear otro Cyber Bit Beast.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Wyatt vuelve y le suplica a Kai que le ayude a entrenar, pero este se niega. Wyatt jura vengarse y acepta entrar en el equipo Psykick y probar el nuevo Cyber Bit Beast. Lucha contra Dunga, y aunque vence al Vortex Ape de éste, la pelea deja muy débil a Wyatt y el doctor B lo echa del equipo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Hilary prepara una barbacoa para que el equipo descanse. El abuelo se cae al río y lo salvan cuatro Bladers que pasan por allí. Tyson se hace amigo de uno de ellos, Kane, pero este resulta ser el jefe del equipo Psykick y está confabulado con Gideon.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Four more will punch their tickets into the next round as GLORY & RISE search for the baddest featherweight on the planet in this year long tournament. On the GLORY side, top ranked German Polish fighter Denis Wosik (40-9-1, 9 KO) takes on Thai veteran Suarek (107-40-11, 39 KO) and Italy’s Achraf Aasila (53-13, 13 KO) meets France’s Lounis Saing (19-4-1, 12 KO). Meanwhile on the RISE side of the bracket, Japan’s Yutaro Asahi (17-9, 4 KO) clashes with Spain’s Eduardo Catalin (17-3-1) and top Japanese prospect Yura Kono (15-1, 7 KO) goes up against China’s Dexiang Kong (35-10). In addition to the Last Featherweight Standing matchups, Shiro Matsumoto (53-17-4, 18 KO) defends his RISE bantamweight title against top challenger Masahi Kumura (24-7, 12 KO) and Australian KO artists Chadd Collins (64-18-2, 32) defends his RISE super lightweight championship against the great Kento Haraguchi (25-4-1, 14 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 103: Last Heavyweight Standing main event features Levi Rigters (19-3, 9 KO) colliding with Jamal Ben Saddik (38-10, 29 KO) to see who moves on in the tournament. Among the other names taking part in Phase Two are Nabil Khachab (29-6-1, 4 KO), Iancu Ionut (31-11, 13 KO), Rade Opacic (21-7, 16 KO), Milos Cvjeticanin (13-4, 9 KO), Sofian Laidouni (39-5-1, 20 KO), and many more. In addition, Chico Kwasi (44-5-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world title against Mehdi Ait El Hadj (35-4-2, 8 KO), Mory Kromah (34-3-1, 20 KO) returns and takes on Cristian Ristea (44-26, 13 KO) in a heavyweight match-up outside the tournament, and Tayfun Ozcan (88-11-3, 28 KO) clashes with rival Don Sno (6-2, 3 KO).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.desc: Celebrate 25 years of "The Crazy Bull" with a high-octane compilation of El Toro Loco’s most legendary moments. This episode captures the sheer intensity of Freestyle competitions as fan-favorite drivers like Lucas Souza and Mark MacDonald push their machines to the ragged edge to chase down rivals like Bounty Hunter. Witness heart-stopping "wow moments," including near-backflips, massive saves, and a dramatic "spin cycle" donut that leaves the track smoking. From mechanical failures like broken drive shafts to the pure adrenaline of bonus time, see why this 12,000-pound beast remains a world-class force in the stadium.

programme.title: World Finals
programme.desc: Get ready to rev your engines for the ultimate showdown as Scott Jordan reveals the massive 28-competitor field heading to Salt Lake City. Sparks will fly as intense rivalries, like the down-to-the-wire championship race between Ryan Anderson and Tyler Menninga, set the stage for epic battles on the dirt. Drivers will push their limits across an array of fierce events, including the JCB Racing, BKT Freestyle, Utah Sports Commission Two Wheel Skills, and Lucas Oil High Jump Championships. With a mix of seasoned veterans and six rookies making their debut in the largest field in over eight years, the stage is set for a historic, high-octane weekend of motorsport madness.

programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: Local Knowledge

Armed with the right crew, the right gear, and a never-quit mindset, the guys roll the dice on an overnight move—hoping to wake up to redemption and put a few quality bluefin on deck.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.

Finally we’ll take a look into the National African American Gun Association and learn how one day at the range for Phillip Smith created the fastest growing firearm organization in the United States.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nikki Boxler’s life in Update New York on her family farm raising cattle and producing maple syrup is a few thousand miles from the hills of New Mexico. We’ll take a look into Nikki’s life back home and then follow along as she visits the small town of Quemado and its bustling population of 228, while she pursues bugling elk with her favorite Winchester in hand. We’ll also head to Missouri and Texas to chase whitetails with Chris Keefer and Paul Sawyer.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: We set out to tell the tale of Marion - and his legendary Mack’s Prairie Wings, smack dab in the middle of the world famous Stuttgart, Arkansas - the land of ducks and rice. Get an inside look at a man that many consider to be larger than life, from those that knew him best, like his cousin and fellow hell raiser, Bud McCollum. We’ll even hear a story or two from Milton Stovesand, an 81 year old former waterfowl guide and Mack’s employee who actually guided John Olin a time or two, and ran the timber holes with Marion. It’s timber holes and tall tales. It’s cups of coffee and cupped up wings. It’s partners in business, and partners in potholes and it’s pure Arkansas...just like Marion.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Melissa Bachman has made her name over the last two decades as one of the most dedicated hunters and producers in the outdoor industry. In this episode we’ll tag along with Melissa while she chases big game around the world with her Winchester in hand. First we’ll head to Colorado as Melissa spot and stalks giant mule deer, then we’ll head across the pond to New Zealand to chase mountain ibex and tar, then head back to the states for Montana whitetail at ground level.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.

programme.title: The Two-Gun Man

programme.desc: The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: A marshal (Jim Davis) uses an outlaw's (Don Megowan) girlfriend (Allison Hayes) as bait to lure him into a showdown.

programme.title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
programme.desc: Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and vows to retake the land that once belonged to his forefathers.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Trouble at a tungsten mine in San Pablo, Mexico.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney tangle with a gang of robbers who have hijacked an Army payroll.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney investigate how U.S. currency in a bank vault was replaced by counterfeit money.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney get reports that a man is selling mines to investors that have been salted; the two g-men are determined to discover the truth.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Kate decides it is time for Betty Jo to put down the books and set out to find a significant other.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: A pair of crooks plans to rob the Cannonball of its bank shipment.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Homer returns to Shady Rest in an attempt to scrap the Cannonball.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: General store clerk Herbie Bates, is name assistant general manager of the Shady Rest by Kate, making Uncle Joe feel like he is being replaced.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie, Lofty and Tagg (Gail Davis, Brad Johnson, Jimmy Hawkins) attend a friend's wedding and investigate the best man's murder.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie (Gail Davis) uncovers a scheme involving honest ranchers, a band of greedy crooks and a valuable oil pool. With Monte Blue, Jim Bannon.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: A contractor agrees to deliver government gunpowder to Geronimo.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie's childhood sweetheart has become an outlaw, the Waco Kid.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: A clumsy fortune-hunter doubles for a notorious gunfighter.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: An outlaw (Myron Healey) poses as a marshal in an attempt to free his brother from jail. With Paul McGuire, Gail Davis.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie (Gail Davis) challenges a mine owner's spoiled rich daughter (Maura Murphy) to a race. With Tom London.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: After being framed and serving seven years in prison, a bitter man (Harry Lauter) returns to town. With Gail Davis.

programme.title: Jesse James Rides Again
programme.desc: On the run from the law over false charges, Jesse James and his friend find refuge in a small town threatened by a gang trying to claim the oil deposits beneath it. While there, he meets a pretty woman and father who are in danger.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: Government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) is accused of shooting up a saloon and has to escape from the jail to find the man behind the murders.

programme.title: Loser's End
programme.desc: A cowboy (Jack Perrin) and his sidekick (Frank Rice) pursue a gang of smugglers and save a Mexican dancer (Tina Menard).

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and sidekick Lucky (Russell Hayden) help a railroad man (Matt Moore) thwart a land baron.

programme.title: Fighting Caravans
programme.desc: A French girl (Lily Damita) joins a wagon train from Missouri led by two scouts and their young partner (Gary Cooper).

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, Dennis Moore, Max Terhune) track outlaws to their hide-out.

programme.title: The Painted Desert
programme.desc: A tungsten miner (Bill Boyd) loves his father's rival's daughter (Helen Twelvetrees) and fights off her other suitor (Clark Gable).

programme.title: And the Crows Will Dig Your Grave
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Wells Fargo hires gunmen to protect against increasing bandit attacks. Jeff Sullivan, driven by revenge for his murdered wife, joins the team to hunt down Glenn Kovacks and his gang. Alongside bounty hunter Pancho Corrales, Sullivan faces treachery, culminating in a deadly showdown where only he survives to save a prisoner.

programme.title: Days of Violence
programme.desc: In the final months of the Civil War, Joe’s brother is unjustly slain by a Northern captain. Consumed by grief and fury, Joe joins a band of Southern fighters who refuse to surrender, seeking justice and redemption amid the dying embers of war.

programme.title: One Dollar Too Many
programme.desc: Suave gambler Clay Watson, cocky sharpshooter Moses Lang, and wily thespian Edwin Kean are a trio of criminals in the Old West.

programme.title: Savage Pampas
programme.desc: In the late 1800's, an army captain tries to tame the open plains of Argentina which are dominated by Indians and bandits. To help do this, the captain brings in a party of women to keep his soldiers happy.

programme.title: Black Tigress
programme.desc: Lola, a saloon dancer, arrives in Sant'Anna, a town terrorized by outlaw El Diablo, who aims to sell the land to a railroad. With the help of Rod, a young admirer, Lola inspires the townspeople to rise up and fight for their land.

programme.title: Hey Amigo! A Toast to Your Death
programme.desc: When bandits seize a struggling town to rob a $100,000 stagecoach, Doc Williams is wrongly blamed for the slaughter that follows. Swearing revenge, he hunts down Burnett’s ruthless gang with help from a quirky ally named El Loco - a man as carefree as he is brave.

programme.title: Troublemakers
programme.desc: Two brothers who hate each other are going to spend Christmas with their mother. She tries to get them together.

programme.title: Sugar Colt
programme.desc: In order to avenge a friend and to fulfill his last wish, Rocco has to find out what happened to an army corps that has mysteriously disappeared. He therefore puts on the disguise of a doctor and starts investigating in a somewhat uncomfortable town.

programme.title: Shoot the Living and Pray for the Dead
programme.desc: After Dan Hogan and his gang rob a bank, they hire a mysterious man to guide them across the Mexican border in return for half of the loot.

programme.title: Twenty Paces to Death
programme.desc: A young half-breed is saved from death and raised as a son by his rescuer. Years later, love and betrayal tear the family apart when he falls for his adoptive sister, while a vengeful woman plots the downfall of the man who once saved them both.

programme.title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
programme.desc: A Civil War veteran swears revenge when he returns home to find his family killed by a local gang.

programme.title: $100,000 for Ringo
programme.desc: Stranger Lee Barton rides into Rainbow Valley, mistaken for a man thought dead. As tensions rise with ruthless town boss Tom Cherry—who's after hidden gold and the affections of a local woman—Barton is drawn into violence and revenge. With a sheriff's help, he seeks justice and a new start with a boy who believes he's his father.

programme.title: Murieta!
programme.desc: The story of Joaquin Murrieta, a real life Mexican bandit who terrorized California with his gang of raiders and cutthroats during the first half of the 19th century. Some saw him as a murderous outlaw, others as the Mexican Robin Hood.

programme.title: The Magnificent Texan
programme.desc: Glenn Saxon, aka El Desperado, seeks justice for Mexicans and vengeance for his family. Orphaned by bandits, he targets the five men responsible, including outlaw Blackie Stark and Judge Wilkins. Amid schemes to control a wealthy daughter’s marriage, El Desperado maneuvers to make the guilty pay.

programme.title: Return of Halleluja
programme.desc: In 1860s Mexico, General Ramirez hires American gunfighter Hallelujah to recover a stolen Aztec statue to win indigenous support. But a Scottish adventurer, feuding brothers, bandits, and the army are also in pursuit, turning the hunt into a chaotic race for power.

programme.title: Ramon the Mexican
programme.desc: Ramon avenges his brother's murder and kills the Baxter Family.

programme.title: Two Crosses at Danger Pass
programme.desc: Judy and Alex are the only two survivors of a punitive mission ordered by the rich and ruthless Moran.... The girl becomes his maid and the boy is adopted by a Quaker family. Alex, despite the philosophy of forgiveness he has been taught, plans to take revenge.

programme.title: Where the Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Young adventurer Gipo owns a fifth of a rock marking a gold mine. With the help of the alluring Lulu Belle, he braves deadly dangers to recover the missing pieces and claim the treasure, facing treachery and peril along the way.

programme.title: Quinto: Fighting Proud
programme.desc: After a bank heist, a gang of outlaws convenes at a desert saloon, only to find the loot missing. Suspicion and paranoia spiral out of control, leading them to turn on each other in a deadly struggle for survival.

programme.title: Against a Crooked Sky
programme.desc: The eldest daughter of a pioneer family is kidnapped by a mysterious Indian tribe and the eldest son pursues. In order to win back his sister's freedom, he must sacrifice his own life by passing the test of "Crooked Sky" and shield his sister from an executioner's arrow. Along the way, he recruits a broken down, drunk prospector to help him track down the unknown tribe and rescue his sister.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, a farmhand, accidentally impersonates the notorious outlaw "Bloody" Ben Harris. Now, on a treasure hunt, he must rely on a group of wild misfits to outsmart the outlaw he's pretending to be. With Harris hot on his trail, Jack must find the treasure and return to his true love, Olivia, before it’s too late.

programme.title: Patience Has a Limit, We Don't
programme.desc: During the Civil War, Corporal MacDonald hides a large gold shipment meant for the Union. Before he can retrieve it, he's killed—taking the secret location with him. Now, a Union lieutenant and MacDonald's two sons compete to uncover the buried treasure in a tense hunt filled with danger and deception.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
programme.desc: A bank that was thought to be impenetrable is robbed by a man wearing the trademark Sartana cloak. Our black-clad hero soon has a price on his head and must try to proof his innocence with the help of his shabby friend Buddy Ben.

programme.title: Clint the Stranger
programme.desc: Clint Harrison is a gunslinger who has been running from vengeful foes for years. He returns to the town he once abandoned and discovers his family has moved away to escape his bad reputation. Seeking redemption, he tracks them down and becomes caught in a violent conflict between farmers and a ruthless rancher willing to kill for land.

programme.title: Quintana: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: In a Mexican province oppressed by the evil Governor Don Juan de Leyra, the rebel-outlaw Quintana is the sole guardian of justice.

programme.title: And God Said to Cain
programme.desc: After ten years in prison for a crime he didn’t commit, ex-Confederate officer Gary Hamilton returns to seek revenge on Acombar, the man who framed him and stole both his gold and his lover. Surrounded by enemies, Hamilton uses the town’s secret tunnels to strike back in a stormy, haunting showdown.

programme.title: Sabata the Killer
programme.desc: Sabata and Mangosta are bank robbers, who after a bank job, through a series of events, end up teaming up with the bank clerk, Peter. They then go on the run with Peter's boss and a hired posse equipped with the latest technology in weapons on their trail.

programme.title: The Cold Killer
programme.desc: José Desman kills his employer, former judge Salazar, who had sentenced his father. This story explores revenge and personal justice as the son confronts the man responsible for his family’s tragedy.

programme.title: Poker with Pistols
programme.desc: After losing everything in a poker game, Lucas takes a risky job delivering a wagon to Chamaco for $5000. But what seems like an easy deal turns into a deadly trap as he crosses paths with ruthless bandits, a corrupt town boss, and a charming saloon girl whose loyalties may not be what they seem.

programme.title: Four Came to Kill Sartana
programme.desc: When bandits begin kidnapping Clayton City’s elite for ransom, Sartana is called in to restore order. But the gang’s mysterious leader sees him as a deadly threat and hires four expert killers to take him down. To save the town and expose the mastermind, Sartana must survive every trap and betrayal.

programme.title: Water
programme.desc: When known rapper Poetic Rhymes goes to jail, he encounters an unusual cellmate that alters his views on reality. When he is released from prison, his new visions and knowledge begins to affect those he loves the most.

programme.title: Triangle Slave
programme.desc: Orphaned brothers Keith and Kareem struggle in the world today after loosing their mother was murdered by their father to pay a debt. Through adversary and perseverance, they rose to become two of the biggest drug kingpins in Philadelphia. But when a woman named Sapphire comes between them, will their empire collapse under the weight of their greed and jealousy?

programme.title: Liquid Dreams
programme.desc: The Dawkins brothers, navigating new careers and relationships, find their bond tested when a wild night of partying sets off a chain of events. Years after their initial adventures, they face fresh challenges that threaten to tear them apart.

programme.title: Bissonnet 2: Back on the Blade
programme.desc: A serial killer is prowling Bissonnet street in Houston, and is targeting prostitutes. Detective Wallace and Benjamin are on the case, and will stop at nothing to bring him to justice.

programme.title: Bunny and Clive
programme.desc: Down and out alcoholic reporter Dougie Pierce has been faced with losing his job for not bringing in a reputable report of anything that is worth reading. That is until one day he runs into the city’s most notorious duo in crime Lola and Clive aka “Bunny & Clive”. When he becomes their hostage, he gets a full on one-on-one interview with this criminal power couple and why they do what they do. He has the most important story of this generation, that is if he makes it out alive to tell it.

programme.title: But You Love Him
programme.desc: High school sweethearts Kelvin and Lydia have been dating for over 10 years. But Lydia’s promiscuous ways will lead them down a dark path and reveal an unspoken truth that will change both of their lives.

programme.title: Caught in a Trapp
programme.desc: The story of a young teen who was abused by his father. Following the tragic death of his parents, he grew up on the streets and is forced into a life of running from D Slug, a known drug lord, after selling drugs from his opps!

programme.title: Dangerous Feelings
programme.desc: Zaria Combs is a happily married woman of 8 years, until Keith, an old flame from her past resurfaces into her life, and at a time when she has been feeling neglected and lonely from her husband Jazper. Keith is released from prison and is determined to win back Zaria and find out who set him up. The two reconnect, and begin to blackmail Jazper. Will there feelings start a new life? Or lead them to road of destruction?

programme.title: Full Clip for a Snitch
programme.desc: Local drug dealers Malik and Chris get arrested for selling to an undercover cop. Facing years in prison, Malik and Chris decide to help the police take down another drug dealer. Malik gets his girlfriend Alicia and Chris to help set up another dealer named Deion. The police arrest Deion and drop the charges against Malik and Chris. Keya then sets out on a mission to murder the people who snitched on her son, before his case goes to trial.

programme.title: Glitter and Grime
programme.desc: Four friends under dire financial circumstance agree to dance at an amateur night in a local strip club. Drawn into the fast money and invigorating lifestyle, they dive deeper into the dark world of dancing, but fast money comes at a dark price.

programme.title: His Masterpiece
programme.desc: Victoria and Richard are divorced spouses that operate an art gallery together. After meeting young artist Daniel at a community event, they decide to collaborate with him on the exhibit to generate income for their tax obligations. However, Richard's aggressive nature and ulterior motives soon come to light, leading to a dangerous jealousy within him.

programme.title: Guilty Victim
programme.desc: A dangerous investor with a violent past is pulled back into chaos when a home security scheme spirals out of control, forcing him to confront old wounds, betrayal, and a brutal fight to protect what little he has left.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Vices
programme.desc: Simone, a married woman battling anxiety and the lingering shadow of her past alcoholism, escapes to collect her thoughts. When a storm isolates her in her remote cabin, she’s hunted by two forces: the seductive pull of her past addiction, and a cunning serial killer. Surrounded by a web of lies and sin, Simone must face her inner demons before a literal one ends her life.

programme.title: 10 Kilos in the Trunk
programme.desc: Tonya needs to make some quick cash for the holidays, and takes a job transporting cocaine. On the way to the drop-off, her car breaks down in the middle of nowhere. While walking to a gas station for help, she is stopped by a police officer, and arrested for several warrants. Now in jail, Tonya, gets her friend Monica to make the delivery. Monica must get the car fixed, avoid a thief looking to steal the product, and make the delivery by the deadline or both will face deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Killing Secret
programme.desc: The outside looking in, Daniel and his wife Brenda appeared to have it all together, but smiles can be deceiving, and kisses can be poison. A healthy marriage is difficult to attain and destroy, but not when secrets are intertwined in the vows, especially one that can kill.

programme.title: The Perfect Wife
programme.desc: A young freelance photographer in Houston meets a beautiful determined teacher from Atlanta. His best friend tries to warn him about her. There is something a little strange about Claudia. Q loves her dearly but she may not be The Perfect Wife.

programme.title: The Perfect Wife 2
programme.desc: The Styles Girls relocate to a new state to start over after the loss of the only place they knew. Unbeknownst to them, the secrets they left behind surface within the walls of their new residence.

programme.title: The Exit Row
programme.desc: Sasha Dade is dedicated to her demanding, yet comfortable life as a wife, mother and advertising executive near the nation's capital. Clint Meyers is a top selling real estate agent and investor who projects sensitivity and charisma but harbors a methodical dark side. Their worlds collide when a chance encounter on a traumatic flight leads to a deadly obsession.

programme.title: The Break of Dawn
programme.desc: After leaving an abusive relationship, college student Dawn Monae discovers that her ex has committed suicide. After some time, she meets a man named Keith online, but her roommates suspect that he isn’t who he says he is. Little do they know, he has an agenda that no one saw coming.

programme.title: The Betrayal 5: Kutthroat Fa Eva
programme.desc: Love, power, and revenge fuel the war between two rival gangs. As blood spills and alliances crumble, a forbidden romance continues to spark in the chaos. But the streets are buzzing with questions about the updates with TK! Is it all part of the plan, or the beginning of the end?

programme.title: Rhythm and Revenge
programme.desc: After losing her parents, Journi, a talented but troubled teenager, moves in with her aunt and cousin for a fresh start. As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her. Suspicion grows, but Journi always seems one step ahead, charming her way out of trouble. However, when the truth starts to unravel, danger lurks closer than anyone could have imagined.

programme.title: Demon Time
programme.desc: William is going through a tumultuous time in his life following the death of his father, and the break up of his girlfriend. As he begins to put his life back together, he discovers his father left behind a substantial debt that could cost him his life. William must face is past, and discover not only his truth, but his father’s as well.

programme.title: The Lineup
programme.desc: Sebastian “Bas” Monte is an up-and-coming influencer and club promoter. He doesn’t have the time to commit to only one woman, so he schedules out different women for his needs. That is until he meets Mikayla, and he questions his playboy ways.

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: Rage: Kill or Be Killed
programme.desc: Jackie “Labrae” Robinson dominates Houston’s unsanctioned boxing circuit—until he comes face-to-face with the one opponent, he never imagined fighting: his personal hero, legendary champion Theo Barnes. However, Theo is a haunted man dealing with his own demons and an advanced case of CTE. A first meeting quickly escalates into an all-out brawl, making the stakes of two champion fighters that much higher.

programme.title: For All Have Sinned
programme.desc: After the sudden death of his mother, Mano embarks on a violent path that stems from his grief and causes him to spiral. He lives by the mantra of Romans 3:23 “for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” When a local church members attempts to reach him, he finds a way to navigate his pain and grief.

programme.title: Vices
programme.desc: Simone, a married woman battling anxiety and the lingering shadow of her past alcoholism, escapes to collect her thoughts. When a storm isolates her in her remote cabin, she’s hunted by two forces: the seductive pull of her past addiction, and a cunning serial killer. Surrounded by a web of lies and sin, Simone must face her inner demons before a literal one ends her life.

programme.title: He'll Still Never Let Go
programme.desc: In the wake of her abusive ex-boyfriend Karlton's disappearance, Candace seeks a fresh start. Just as she begins to open her heart to new love, Brandon, his reckless actions inadvertently expose her to danger, unaware that Karlton is silently watching. With her past closing in and her safety at risk, Candace must confront her deepest fears and fight to reclaim her freedom before Karlton's sinister plans destroy her chance at happiness.

programme.title: The Housekeeper

Struggling to find steady work, Sharease agrees to become a live-in housekeeper for a local crime boss, Zues. The pairs professional relationship soon turns intimate, but it’s only a veil of secrets and lies. Will Sharease survive the truth?

Watch as Ron Shuffield, the underdog from Arkansas, redeems a poor showing from the previous year with a masterful performance, hauling in over 60 pounds of bass. Featuring intense competition, expert commentary, and the strategic use of lipless crankbaits in pepper grass, this episode captures the grit and glory of tournament fishing.

programme.desc: One woman’s personal mission to reduce her household rubbish turned into a passion that gave birth to Southeast Asia’s first Zero-Waste Bulk Food shop. Claire is a driven and successful mother of three who turned away from her corporate job to channel her business-savvy into reducing our impact on the environment and contributing to the improvement of her local community.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Zaira (Argentina)
programme.desc: For a long time Zaira let herself be defined solely as a survivor of the traumatic sexual assault that marked her life. In her healing search, she left behind the busy city life and moved to seek solace in the mountains of Mendoza. - It is among these magnificent peaks that Zaira found peace within herself and harmony with her surroundings. Now, eager to help others heal, she is the leader of a trekking initiative that doubles as a support group for other women who are victims of sexual aggression.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Ile (Argentina)
programme.desc: Ileana studied business and worked long hours indoors for a multinational logistics company. Her love for dance and desire for movement drove her to quit her corporate life and begin a new chapter as a fitness trainer. Quickly exhausting the traditional methods available at her local gyms, she began to create innovative and groundbreaking exercise methods of her own. Her goal: to empower women by making them feel strong and feminine at the same time.

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 2 - So the great rivers may live - Part 1
programme.desc: Water and its beauty, water and its power, water and its fragility... the water we all need is becoming scarce, through our own fault. Some rivers are dry, others are diverted, cut off by dams, others are simply polluted, and this for decades. We will discover how humans transformed the nature in Argentina, then in China and its disproportionate Three Gorges Dam. We will also go in Botswana with the Okavango, this unique river which flows into a desert forming the famous Okavango Delta. Vu du Ciel makes you discover once again another world, magnificent but threatened.

programme.title: Reset - Season 1 - France, Le Bruit de l'eau
programme.desc: In this episode of Reset, we take you to “Le Bruit de l'eau”, an ecolodge nestled in the heart of the Baie de Somme nature reserve, in France. In the middle of nature, discover a place of absolute serenity inspired by the Japanese lifestyle and the travels of a great reporter, its founder. - The intimate atmosphere that reigns at Le Bruit de l'eau (The Sound of Water) envelops you in a soothing calm, creating a cocoon made for relaxation and personal rejuvenation. - This ecolodge allows us to cultivate awareness of the present moment and to open up to a fulfilling perception of our environment. Le Bruit de l'eau opens the doors to a transformative experience, where beauty of the natural environment merges with quest for serenity.

programme.title: Reset - Season 1 - Sri Lanka, Santani
programme.desc: In this episode of Reset, we fly to Sri Lanka to discover an old tea plantation transformed into a sumptuous refuge: Santani. - In order to find an alternative to the stress of urban life, the hotel offers a modern approach to Ayurveda. This traditional Indian medicine aims to establish a balance between the individual and the world around them. Thanks to the development of a personalized program, each visitor is invited to find harmony within this restorative sanctuary. - Santani was created by a Sri Lankan eager to preserve our physical and spiritual well-being in a peaceful and healthy place to reconnect with the world differently. Let's discover a holistic approach to health, including Ayurvedic medicine and the ancient practices of yoga and meditation. Santani opens the doors to a world of tranquility.

programme.title: My Day Dubai - Season 1 - Atlantis
programme.desc: In this episode, our presenter Gabriela will visit Sustainable City in Dubai. She will discover how the residents garden, how they dress in sustainable clothes and, of course, how they eat by preparing healthy recipes. She will end her day with a Qigong class with a Qigong master.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The flavors of chocolate
programme.desc: Today, the gluttons should not be disappointed since chocolate is in the spotlight. Discovered by the Mayans 2500 years ago and then more widely by the Aztecs, chocolate is today one of the favorite products in the world. And make no mistake about it: just as the kitchen has its great chefs, chocolate also has its great chocolatiers. - As for recipes, Julie will introduce you to a cake that is only made in Saint Émilien and which combines chocolate with macarons, before heading to the Basque Country for a dessert to spice you up. We will then climb up the mountain to meet a Swiss cook. Finally, you will see that chocolate has several surprises in store for us: it has many virtues and is also used for well-being.

Much more than a hotel, this place is a natural haven where everything is made to relax while overlooking the Pacific. While relaxation is key, we also seek adventures, don’t we? programme.title: My Zen Trendy - Season 1 - Surfing & Vineyards
programme.desc: Yoga and Surf are two corner stones of the Californian spirit. In this episode, the best of both worlds meets as Val shares a surf session with a local champion from Malibu! What about the surfing outfit ? No need for it, there is a yoga mat. Let’s head to Ojai, in the middle of a vineyards, and joint the "Topa Wines" group for a yoga session at the sunset. Together, we will enjoy the "Pink moment": the time when Ojai’s mountains turn pink and your mind is blown away.

programme.title: My First Garden - Season 1 - Repotting an indoor plant
programme.desc: We meet in the market garden of Romainville to learn how to take good care of our indoor plants. The plants that grow in our houses and flats are grown in pots. And when we buy a new plant, it is very important to repot it. The plants we buy come in pots that are often too small for them to grow well. That's why you put it in a bigger pot.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Agostina (Argentina)
programme.desc: When Agostina’s mother was diagnosed with breast cancer, she began seeking out soft natural fabrics that would not irritate her mother’s sensitive skin. She found it almost impossible to find the right materials, so she decided to make her own. Research led her to bamboo fibers and she realised she could make a positive impact on the environment, while developing sustainable and ethical fashion.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Solenn (Nantes)
programme.desc: A former school teacher reinvents herself when she discovers a passion for sharing other women’s stories. Always inspired by the journeys of strong women, Solenn began a blog to celebrate the women in her community. - Solenn’s energy and passion fueled a dream of starting her own magazine. Thanks to a successful crowdfunding campaign, this dream blossomed into a professional career in journalism and she launched a print mook (magazine & book) called Etonnantes. Etonnantes features interviews of women of all backgrounds, celebrating their diversity and success in each field.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Sophie (Nantes)
programme.desc: Always an artist at heart, Sophie grew up in the countryside amongst nature and farm animals.
